sections.text: SQSTM1::NTRK1 has been detected in thyroid carcinomas. The primary cohort documents the upstream partner and NTRK fusion junctions; these alterations retain a carboxy-terminal TRK-containing product.

sections.text: An oncogenic NTRK fusion without a known acquired TRK resistance mutation is a larotrectinib biomarker in adults and children with advanced solid tumors after progression or without satisfactory alternatives; the indication also requires metastatic disease or surgery associated with severe morbidity.

report_comment.text: SQSTM1 encodes sequestosome 1/p62. NTRK1 encodes TRKA, a neurotrophin receptor tyrosine kinase. SQSTM1::NTRK1 has been detected in thyroid carcinomas. The primary cohort documents the upstream partner and NTRK fusion junctions; these alterations retain a carboxy-terminal TRK-containing product. An oncogenic NTRK fusion without a known acquired TRK resistance mutation is a larotrectinib biomarker in adults and children with advanced solid tumors after progression or without satisfactory alternatives; the indication also requires metastatic disease or surgery associated with severe morbidity.
